title: Google Local business
statusNote: Active. Restaurant carousel is limited access (small set of restaurant providers, interest form).
notes: Use the most specific LocalBusiness subtype; multiple types as an array (additionalType not supported).

LocalBusiness is a subtype of Organization so the Organization fields also apply. aggregateRating/review only recommended for sites that capture reviews about OTHER local businesses. geo.latitude/longitude precision at least 5 decimals. openingHoursSpecification: single object or array; dayOfWeek values Monday..Sunday (https://schema.org/ prefix or short names); opens/closes hh:mm:ss; validFrom/validThrough are YYYY-MM-DD seasonal closure dates. priceRange must be shorter than 100 chars.

Restaurant carousel (limited): Carousel with required image (repeated URL/ImageObject) and name; recommended address, servesCuisine. department is a nested LocalBusiness (name format '{store} {department}').
